correctness.rationale: The exact weak-p norm on finite ell_1 generators is established in arXiv:2101.03510. Applying the finite permutation orbit to an arbitrary input gives |f(x)|^p ≤ ||f||^p max_a c_a(x), with precise multiplicity independent of stabilizers. Summing orbit costs gives the r-bound while ordinary pointwise p-convexity gives the k-bound. The orbit-average functions have norm one and their disjoint-support evaluations force equality. At p=infinity the free AM supremum norm gives one. All quantifiers, zero inputs, and endpoint conventions are addressed; 229362 exact finite cost comparisons plus 2667 lower-witness identities are supplementary.

value.rationale: The k-ary positive maximum modulus is an intrinsic and motivated Banach-lattice invariant quantifying failure of the AM property. The theorem completely classifies it for every arity, finite coordinate dimension, real exponent p≥1 and permutation subgroup, yielding a sharp orbit-count saturation that generic p-convexity does not supply. Orbit sizes and internal group structure disappear, demonstrating a structural resource-count mechanism rather than an isolated computation.
